Pool control built for today.

A clean dashboard showing everything your system reports. Instant controls that respond without delay. Complete temperature, pump, salt, and heater data — all in one place, not buried across five sub-menus.

Stable

Connects fast.
Stays connected.

PoolOS caches your controller's connection on first use. Every reconnect after that — on your home WiFi or remotely via your ScreenLogic relay — is nearly instant.

Automatic retry handles network hiccups in the background. Your last known pool status is always visible, even before the connection is live.

Smart caching means instant reconnects

Storm Watch · Free

Your pool knows when
a storm is coming.

Push notifications before severe weather arrives — not after. Free: no subscription, no PoolOS login. Turn on Storm Watch in Settings (with pool location for alerts). Built into every PoolOS download.

Tornado & thunderstorm warnings
NWS-issued alerts delivered to your phone before conditions turn dangerous — enough time to act, not just react.
Flash flood & high wind alerts
The events that matter when you have outdoor equipment running. Know before your pool equipment has to deal with it.
Powered by official alerts
NOAA / NWS severe weather products — no separate weather service account. After you opt in, alerts run in the background.
Free for every PoolOS user — no subscription required

Privacy

Pool control stays yours.

Day-to-day equipment control travels between your iPhone and your pool controller — Pentair over your Wi-Fi (and Pentair’s relay when you’re away), or Jandy through your existing iAquaLink cloud account. PoolOS does not send Pentair pool traffic to PoolOS-operated servers.

Optional features are explicit: free Storm Watch sends push registration and pool location so alerts can reach your phone; PoolOS Pro uses Apple for payment and our entitlement service for grants — never third-party ad or analytics SDKs, and we don’t sell personal information. Read the full Privacy Policy.

No PoolOS login required to run your pool — Pentair uses the same ScreenLogic pathway as Pentair’s app; Jandy uses your iAquaLink credentials.
